channel.title: Lineup Confirmed
channel.description: Lineup Confirmed tracks who is starting today across sports: NHL starting goalies, MLB probable pitchers and closers, NBA injury status, Premier League lineups and NFL starting quarterbacks. Every starter is labeled expected or confirmed and linked to its source.

item.title: Canucks Project Leevi Merilainen vs. Wild as Quinn Hughes Returns, Oct. 25, 2026
item.description: Leevi Merilainen is projected to start for Vancouver against Minnesota on Sunday after Kevin Lankinen played Thursday. Calvin Pickard is confirmed for the Wild.

item.title: Islanders Expect Ilya Sorokin vs. Jake Oettinger in Dallas, Oct. 25, 2026
item.description: The Islanders' own game preview says Ilya Sorokin is expected to start at Dallas on Sunday, against an expected Jake Oettinger. Neither start had been officially confirmed when we published.

item.title: Jets Goalie for Heritage Classic: Skinner or Stevenson After Hellebuyck Trade; Canadiens Starter Not Announced
item.description: Winnipeg plays its first game since trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson as its two NHL goalies. Neither the Jets nor the Canadiens had confirmed a Heritage Classic starter in the sources we checked.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Monday, Oct. 26, 2026: Kings-Rangers, Leafs-Flames, Red Wings-Oilers
item.description: Monday's three-game NHL slate has no confirmed starters yet. Here is who started each team's last game, from official NHL box scores, so you know what to watch for.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Tonight (Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026): Schmid, Knight and Pickard Confirmed; Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner Expected
item.description: Five NHL games Sunday. Akira Schmid and Spencer Knight started in Chicago, and Calvin Pickard is confirmed for Minnesota. Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner, Wedgewood, Annunen and Merilainen are expected.

item.title: Panthers Confirm Akira Schmid in Goal at Blackhawks Tonight; Blackhawks Expected to Turn to Soderblom
item.description: Florida confirms Akira Schmid starts Sunday at Chicago with Jacob Markstrom injured. NHL.com projects Arvid Soderblom for Chicago after Spencer Knight's five straight starts.

item.title: Predators Close Back-to-Back vs. Avalanche After Saros' 34-Save Night in Pittsburgh
item.description: Nashville hosts Colorado on the second night of a back-to-back after Juuse Saros played Saturday in Pittsburgh, and the team is skipping its morning skate. Neither club has confirmed a starter.

item.title: Wild Confirm Calvin Pickard Starts at Canucks Tonight on Back-to-Back
item.description: Minnesota coach John Hynes split the weekend back-to-back: Jesper Wallstedt started Saturday at Seattle and Calvin Pickard starts Sunday in Vancouver. The Canucks have not confirmed their goalie.
